description: Use when a Kubernetes request is refused by RBAC: "Error from server (Forbidden)", "User ... cannot list resource ... in the namespace" or "at the cluster scope", a ServiceAccount, controller, CI job or person getting 403, a RoleBinding that does not seem to apply (wrong namespace, wrong subject, a ClusterRole bound with a RoleBinding), "is attempting to grant RBAC permissions not currently held", "roleRef ... field is immutable", 401 Unauthorized versus 403 Forbidden, or a custom resource that `view` cannot read. Investigates with kubectl auth can-i, get and describe, and proposes fixes. Reads first and asks before changing anything.
